title: Лижет лапы по ночам: что проверить
text:
Your dog licks their paws all night and you're lying awake listening to it. Here's what pet parents tell us they check first 🧵
—
1. Walks. Grass, pollen and sidewalk salt stick to paws. A quick wipe after every walk is the easiest habit to start.
2. Changes. New food, new treats, new shampoo in the last month? Write it down, it helps your vet a lot.
—
3. Ears and skin folds. Redness or a yeasty smell is worth mentioning at the next checkup.
4. Raw skin, bleeding or limping = a vet visit, not a home routine.
What's your dog's itchy season? 🐾

title: 2 часа ночи, собаку тошнит: спокойный чек-лист
text:
It's 2am and your dog is dry-heaving. A calm checklist to save for the 2am version of you 🧵
—
1. Note the time, what they ate today and whether a toy or sock is missing.
2. Dry heaving with a swollen, hard belly = call an emergency vet now. Don't wait for morning.
—
3. One episode, acting normal, drinking water? Keep watching, offer small sips and call your vet in the morning.
When in doubt, call. You know your dog best 🧡

title: Праздничный стол: что можно, что нельзя
text:
Thanksgiving table, pet edition 🦃🧵
—
Usually OK in small, plain bites: plain turkey (no skin, no bones), plain pumpkin, green beans.
—
Keep off the plate: cooked bones, onions, grapes and raisins, chocolate, and anything with xylitol (some desserts and peanut butters).
Not a full list. Not sure about something? Ask your vet before sharing 🧡
note: ⚠️ Чеснок в список «нельзя» сознательно не включён: в наших Flea & Tick treats есть чеснок (в базе Контент-завода стоит пометка «GARLIC dog-safety review»). Сначала нужно решение по этой пометке.

title: Когда лоток — повод ехать к ветеринару сегодня
text:
When your cat's litter box habits mean a vet visit today, not tomorrow 🧵
—
• Straining with little or nothing coming out
• Blood in the litter
• Crying in the box
• Suddenly peeing outside the box
—
A male cat who strains and can't pee is an emergency. Call right away.
Save this and send it to a cat parent you love 🧡

title: Supplement или medicine — честно
text:
Supplement or medicine? A quick, honest thread 🧵
—
Medicine: prescribed by your vet for a diagnosed problem.
Supplement: daily support for things like gut, skin & coat and everyday comfort.
—
We make supplements. We won't promise to fix anything, and you should be careful with anyone who does.
Ask us anything below, we'll answer every question 👇
note: Это не продажа, а позиция бренда (USP «Supplement NOT a Medicine»): объясняем, кто мы. Ни товаров, ни ссылок. На вопросы о симптомах — отправлять к ветеринару.
